landing_page_summary: Hub page covers: the business case for cloud ERP migration; five strategic approaches (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Repurchase, Retire); a five-phase roadmap (discovery, planning, data migration, testing, go-live); key benefits (OpEx vs CapEx, security, scalability); common pitfalls (hidden costs, downtime, data sovereignty); and FAQs. It is a broad, strategy-oriented overview — does NOT go deep on brownfield/greenfield/bluefield tradeoffs, public vs private edition selection, post-migration challenges, TCO/cost framework, data security regulations, or the GROW vs RISE distinction.

metrics.trend: Rising sharply — SAPinsider reports record migration volumes before SAP ECC mainstream support end (2027). Garuda Indonesia migrated to RISE with SAP in early 2026. ISG 2026 survey: 60% of SAP migration projects ran over budget/time.

key_facts_for_briefs.ecc_deadline: SAP ECC mainstream maintenance ends 2027; extended support available until 2030 at +2% premium (total +9–12% above annual increases)
key_facts_for_briefs.rise_vs_grow: RISE with SAP = large enterprise, private cloud, brownfield-friendly; GROW with SAP = mid-market, public cloud, greenfield/net-new
key_facts_for_briefs.migration_approaches: Greenfield (rebuild from scratch); Brownfield (system conversion in-place); Bluefield/Selective Data Transition (selective — mix of both)
key_facts_for_briefs.downtime: Near-Zero Downtime (NZDT) methodology: delta migration slices keep source system live during main migration
key_facts_for_briefs.cost_data: Extended maintenance 2028–2030: +2% of maintenance base per year = total +9–12% over base; data migration cost range Rp 10–75 juta depending on volume
key_facts_for_briefs.budget_risk: ISG 2026 survey: 60% of SAP migration projects ran over budget or time regardless of approach
key_facts_for_briefs.post_migration: 82% of SAP users cite poor data management/integration as biggest post-migration challenge (data integrity); 47% face skills gaps; 49% face integration challenges
key_facts_for_briefs.indonesia_cloud_security: UU PDP (Law No. 27/2022) fully effective Oct 2024; BSSN Reg. No. 8/2020 mandates info security management; 67% of Indonesian public sector has adopted cloud (BSSN stat)
key_facts_for_briefs.garuda_case: Garuda Indonesia migrated to SAP Cloud ERP Private (RISE with SAP) in 2026 to cut costs and unify fragmented systems — cited by Indonesian media
